Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

response.text:
SF18 3-position enabling device | has | 3 switch positions: off, on, off | | A 3-position enabling device has 3 switch positions: off, on, off (in order of actuation when squeezing).
SF18 3-position enabling device | is off | when released completely | | When released completely, the device is off.
SF18 3-position enabling device | is on | when pressed to the centre position in manual mode | in manual mode | In manual mode, when pressed/squeezed to the centre position, it is on.
SF18 motion | is enabled | when the 3P enabling device is ON | | When the 3P enabling device is "ON", motion is enabled.
SF18 input | goes LOW | when the device is completely pressed (squeezed) | | Completely pressing (squeezing) results in an off state.
SF18 external enabling device connection OFF | triggers | SF2 (Stop Category 2) | in Manual Mode | When in Manual Mode and when an external Enabling Device connection is OFF, internally the safety system initiates SF2, which is a Stop Category 2 (IEC 60204-1 / SS2 IEC 61800-5-2).
SF18 usage | recommended | use with a mode switch as a safety input | | Recommendation: Use with a mode switch as a safety input.
SF19 outputs | are HIGH | in Automatic Mode ("running") | | In Automatic Mode ("running"), SF19's outputs are HIGH.
SF19 enabling device in safety OFF state | triggers | SF2 (Stop Category 2) | in Manual Mode | In Manual Mode and when any Enabling Device is in the Safety OFF state (not in the centre-ON position...), a SF2 is triggered causing a Stop Category 2 (SS2).
SF19 outputs | are LOW | in Manual Mode when the 3PE is in the Off state | in Manual Mode | In manual mode, when the 3PE is in the Off state, the outputs are Low and SF2 is triggered.
SF19 outputs with Freedrive | are HIGH | when Freedrive is activated and ALL 3PE are in the OFF state | Freedrive activated | If Freedrive is activated and ALL 3PE are in the OFF state, SF19's outputs are HIGH.
SF19 outputs with Freedrive | are LOW | when Freedrive is not activated and any 3PE is in the OFF state | Freedrive not activated | If Freedrive is not activated, and any 3PE is in the OFF state, SF19's outputs are LOW.
